question: Does the bounded cross-view reference-consensus proposal set cover target door 10 in all three query views of the preselected sixth family?

contributors: highest layer18_local_appearance_score minus 0.05 times minimum absolute log-area deviation to any of the three reference target boxes
highest layer18_nids_fused_score constrained to the majority winning target reference across all three query observations
hypothesis_generation.reference_vote: Each query contributes its semantic-local fusion top-one winning target reference. Select the majority reference; break ties by deterministic sorted reference order.
hypothesis_generation.deduplication: Merge contributors only when tile_id, postprocess_index and exact box coordinates are identical.
hypothesis_generation.tie_break: Use the frozen base scorer's deterministic higher layer-18 local, target-memory and objectness scores, then lexicographic box and postprocess index.
hypothesis_generation.truth_boundary: No target box, IoU, target mask or target coverage enters reference voting, candidate generation, candidate ranking or deduplication.

literature_motivation.source: Simultaneous Multi-View Instance Detection With Learned Geometric Soft-Constraints
literature_motivation.use: Appearance and cross-view geometry can jointly disambiguate similar neighboring instances. Mechanism motivation only.
Complementary views and cross-view consistency can reduce ambiguity from independent pairwise matching. Mechanism motivation only.

forbidden_after_freeze: change any contributor, score, 0.05 penalty, reference vote, deterministic tie break, deduplication, maximum set size or IoU gate
use query truth, sibling appearance or controls in hypothesis generation
add a fourth hypothesis, rescue a failed query or reinterpret proposal coverage as top-one localization
claim_boundary: A pass confirms only bounded proposal recall on one wholly new sixth 3RScan family under provider truth and a maximum set size of three. A failure with no reachable candidate is a proposal-carrier limitation, not evidence against source observability. Neither outcome confirms top-one localization, calibrated uncertainty, open-set rejection, instance ownership, referent identity, named entrance, affordance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability or safety.
